nodes.text: At Camp Antonidas, investigate the lingering images by the mosaic, ruined tower, workshop and pavilion. Interact with each image rather than only flying past the structures, and check all four investigation objectives.

recovery.text: Return to Noriko and use her lift dialogue if the Ancient Remains do not appear. The Echo of Loss is one floor below the remains. Descend safely; a direct drop from the tower can kill a character.

nodes.text: At Noriko the All-Remembering, accept For The Love of Others.

recovery.text: Return to Noriko and use her lift dialogue if the Ancient Remains do not appear. The Echo of Loss is one floor below the remains. Descend safely; a direct drop from the tower can kill a character.

nodes.text: Speak to Noriko and ask her to send you to the ruined tower’s upper area; flying there directly can miss the trigger. Inspect the Ancient Remains, descend one floor to defeat the Echo of Loss, then return safely to Noriko in camp. Review the toy in the reward dialogue.

writtenDestination.policy: Use this quest’s current objective marker or quest-log search area; the acceptance point is not an objective pin.

nodes.text: Hand in For The Love of Others to Noriko the All-Remembering, using this quest’s current end marker. Finish any dialogue; acceptance and completed objectives are not the hand-in. Review the reward panel and retain the toy reward; choose it if the panel presents a choice.

writtenDestination.label: Noriko the All-Remembering
writtenDestination.policy: Resolve the actual end marker. Never substitute the cached acceptance point for a different endpoint.

nodes.text: Retain Compendium of Love from the completed reward. If the quest is finished but the toy is missing, inspect bags, bank and pending mail before assuming it was learned.

recovery.text: Inspect the actual reward, bags and bank. A turned-in quest alone cannot establish receipt or account ownership. If the reward is missing, keep this unresolved; Continue does not create it.

nodes.text: Use the received toy from your bags to add it to the Toy Box. The route ends only when the game reports ownership of this exact toy.

interfaceObservation.purpose: Player uses the received toy or upgrade kit; no automatic learning.

recovery.text: Keep receipt separate from learning. Inspect the actual Toy Box entry and received item. If a restriction prevents use, preserve the item and defer; a click on Continue does not mark ownership.
